News & Events

Stay updated with the latest from Lesotho Tech Academy

Featured15 March 2026
Lesotho Tech Academy Students Win Big at LSMTA Science Fair 2026

We are incredibly proud to announce that a Lesotho Tech Academy instructor mentored three talented students who participated in the LSMTA District Science Fair 2026. Under the Primary Technology category, the students delivered outstanding projects that earned them top honours at the district level.

Their exceptional performance at the district fair earned them a place at the prestigious LSMTA National Science and Mathematics Fair 2026, held at the Manthabiseng Convention Centre in Maseru District. Competing against the best young minds from across Lesotho, two of the three students emerged victorious — clinching both 1st Prize and 2nd Prize in their category.

This remarkable achievement highlights the dedication of our instructor and the potential of Lesotho's young learners when given the right mentorship and skills. At Lesotho Tech Academy, we believe in nurturing practical technology skills from an early age, and this victory is proof that our approach is bearing fruit.

We congratulate the winning students and their mentor for representing Lesotho Tech Academy with excellence at the national stage. Their success inspires us to keep empowering the next generation of innovators in Lesotho.

Announcement
Online Classes Now in Progress
10 April 2026

Our online learning platform is now live! Students can attend classes from anywhere in Lesotho. All four courses are available online with interactive sessions, video lectures, and hands-on projects.

New Course
New Course: Business Development Systems
1 April 2026

We are excited to announce the launch of our newest 3-month programme — Business Development Systems. This course covers entrepreneurship, digital marketing, project management, and business strategy for the modern economy.

Update
M-Pesa & EcoCash Payment Now Available
20 March 2026

Paying for your registration and tuition fees is now easier than ever! We now accept M-Pesa and EcoCash payments alongside bank transfers. Simply use the reference number provided after submitting your application.

Enrollment
Registration Open for 2026 Intake
5 March 2026

Registration is now open for the 2026 academic intake. Secure your spot in Web Development, Computer Networks, CMS Development, or Business Development Systems. Pay only M300 to register!

Spotlight
Founder Relebohile Mohono Featured in Tech
15 February 2026

Our founder, Relebohile Joseph Mohono, has been featured in leading technology publications for his vision of transforming IT education in Lesotho. Read about his journey from Leribe to building one of the country's premier tech academies.

Community
Lesotho Tech Academy Partners with Local Schools
1 February 2026

We are proud to announce new partnerships with local schools across Leribe District. Through these collaborations, we aim to introduce coding and technology skills to secondary school students, building the next generation of Basotho tech leaders.
